name: JK Flip-Flop
description: When both inputs are off, there is no change in state. If both Set and Reset are set to on, the state will be toggled.
shortDescription: A JK flip-flop that can be set and reset using two on/off inputs.

logicNodes.label: Output
logicNodes.description: The internal state of the flip-flop.

logicNodes.label: NOT Output
logicNodes.description: The inverse of the internal state of the flip-flop.
